show.name: Wan Jie Du Zun
show.summary: Lin Feng was gathering his martial soul in the Lin Mansion. He didn't want to. His fiancee Ji Manyao took the opportunity to take his martial soul, and he almost vomited blood and died. At the same time, Lin Feng's spirit entered the land of the burial of the gods. The mysterious woman in the land of the burials told Lin Feng that he could gain enormous martial arts power and knowledge by obliterating the ancient gods buried here.

show.name: Spare Me, Great Lord!
show.summary: This is the story of an orphan, Lu Shu. He is not any regular orphan, but a metahuman experiencing the changes in himself, his country and the world during the dawn of the magical era. Watch as Lu Shu embarks on a journey to hone his peculiar abilities together with his sister, the adorable and charismatic Lu Xiaoyu. Along the way, they'll encounter supernatural events, obstacles and even the most powerful people in their country. How will Lu Shu make the best of his abilities and oust his never-ending list of rivals and opponents?

show.name: Тейбл Тайм
show.summary: Table Time is a show in which four friends gather in a country house for all night to remember their childhood and play board games that everyone has prepared for each other.

show.name: Soul Land 2: The Unrivaled Tang Sect
Soul Land 2: The Unrivaled Tang Sect
show.summary: The Tang Sect in a turbulent world. There is nothing but martial spirit here. Ten thousand years after the founding of the Tang Sect, it is in relative decline. An extremely talented man was born. Can the new Shrek Seven Monsters revive the Tang Sect and bring it back to glory? A soul beast of over one million years old; Electrolux who can pick stars; The new soul utensil system that led to the decline of the Tang Sect... A lot of secrets are to be revealed. Can the secret weapons of the Tang Sect be sharp again? Can the Tang Sect regain its former glory?

show.name: Fanren Xiu Xian Chuan Zhi Fanren Feng Qi Tian Nan
Fanren Xiu Xian Chuan Zhi Fanren Feng Qi Tian Nan
show.summary: A poor and ordinary boy from a village joins a minor sect in Jiang Hu and becomes an Unofficial Disciple by chance. How will Han Li, a commoner by birth, establish a foothold for himself in in his sect? With his mediocre aptitude, he must successfully traverse the treacherous path of cultivation and avoid the notice of those who may do him harm. This is a story of an ordinary mortal who, against all odds, clashes with devilish demons and ancient celestials in order to find his own path towards immortality.

show.name: Klassen
show.summary: Livet i klassen er som en berg- og dalbane av kjærlighet, vennskap og samhold.

show.name: Let's Go
show.summary: During the Republic of China era, Wang Laowu, a veterinarian by trade, accidentally becomes the county magistrate of Fuhu County. Once in office, he encounters endless troubles and fights his way through every obstacle in this absurd, comic tale. Centering on ordinary people, the drama reveals how small characters forge a grand era in Republican China.

show.name: Sunshine Through The Rain
show.summary: This is the story of the headstrong girl Zheng Yu and the lonely boy Chen Yan Zhou. Burdened by her family's poverty, Zheng Yu must take on heavy responsibilities, while Chen Yan Zhou withdraws into himself after the death of his older brother. From school rivals, they gradually become a light in each other's lives, facing life's storms together.

show.name: Thirty-Six Stratagems: Slay
show.summary: When the Strait Command Tower is hit, Yan Zizhou, also known as Night Blade, is assigned to investigate, only for his sister Xiaoxiao to suddenly plunge from a building. Using the Thirty-Six Stratagems, he joins forces with his second brother Zong Xiaoquan, and Li Li, Xiaoxiao's separated twin sister, to help local police reveal, through Li Luo, the case of their parents' murder eighteen years earlier and bring He Huan and her sibling, Kang Qingtian, and the other chief culprits to justice.

show.name: Vow of Autumn
show.summary: Deceived by a married jerk, lawyer Wen Wanqing gets drunk and accidentally kisses her best friend's younger brother, surgeon Pei Yiqiu—who has secretly loved her for years. As misunderstandings give way to romance, she breaks free from her toxic relationship, while he offers the tenderness she's always deserved. A two-way journey that began in their youth finally comes full circle, bringing them both a chance to heal.

show.name: A-laget
show.summary: There will be revelations, laughter and tears when famous people are challenged by atypical reporters with critical, surprising and unfiltered questions.

body.name: Episode 1
body.summary: 1982, East Berlin. MI6 officer Martha Schmitt must maintain her humiliating cover identity as an ordinary East German woman having an affair with British diplomat Graham Anderson. She yearns for serious work, but when the chance to prove herself arrives, she botches it. To redeem herself, she is paired with Kurt Fischer, a CIA officer who ruined her mission. But the Stasi's fearsome Friedrich Baumann has been observing Martha. When he makes a request of her, how can she refuse?

show.name: Honey
show.summary:
Honey goes deep undercover in 1980s East Berlin to explore a shadowy world of counter espionage and risky but irresistible relations. 

East Berlin, 1982. Martha, 24, is a deep cover agent for MI6. Surrounded by enemies and constantly under threat of her cover being blown, she tries her hardest to avoid detection by Friedrich Bauman, the new Head of Counter Espionage for the Stasi. Finding herself caught between Friedrich and the reckless, arrogant (and incredibly attractive…) CIA operative Aaron Neeland, she is blind-sided by desire in this Cold War menage-a-trois. The risk of being garrotted or incarcerated is nothing compared to the horrifying ordeal of falling in love. Allowing yourself to be vulnerable and bearing your heart and soul? She'd rather have her fingernails ripped off.

body.name: Episode 2
body.summary: Having survived her close brush with Friedrich, Martha investigates Hermann's murder with Kurt. A sceptical Friedrich orders his men, the inept Otto and Rolf, to also investigate it. After the Stasi seize Hermann's notebook, Martha and Kurt must infiltrate his workplace, a strange sausage factory. They meet Kamilla, his sweet colleague – will she be the key to locating Greta? Meanwhile, now a fugitive, a terrified and confused Greta is running out of options for refuge. Where can she turn?

show.name: When I Meet the Moon
show.summary: The socially anxious Yun Li applies for a postgraduate program in Nanwu to prove her independence to her father. A day before the semester begins, she is invited to a local virtual reality (VR) center as a video creator. There, she reunites with Fu Shize, the genius and her high school crush. She gradually opens up, and, with the help of others, goes all out to court her dream man, winning him over with her warmth and radiance. However, amid the loving moments, their differing perspectives eventually lead to a breakup. When she goes abroad, his deeply suppressed trauma is brought to the forefront. To win her back, he gets back on his feet, leading his team to new heights in scientific research. When she returns to China, he pursues her relentlessly, and the two overcome their differences and rekindle their love.

show.name: The Silent Storm
show.summary: In 1994, tax auditor Ouyang Xu, criminal investigator Yan Ping'an, and Zhou Haiyang—who was searching for his missing wife—met through a counterfeit invoice case in Chunjiang City. Under the tide of the times, the three experienced vastly different circumstances, and their fates gradually diverged. Years later, Operation Grain Rain brings them together again—but the brothers of old now stand on opposite sides. Ouyang Xu faces off against the tax fraud ring led by Zhou Haiyang and the protective umbrella behind it, caught in a painful choice between emotion and the law. Starting from a single invoice, he tears away the veil of greed and ultimately eliminates evil, safeguarding justice.

Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony
show.summary: Leaders in the music industry joined together in 1983 to establish the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Foundation. One of the Foundation's many functions is to recognize the contributions of those who have had a significant impact on the evolution, development and perpetuation of rock and roll by inducting them into the Hall of Fame!

show.name: World Wonder Ring STARDOM
show.summary: World Wonder Ring Stardom, legal name Kabushiki Gaisha Stardom (株式会社スターダム Kabushiki Gaisha Sutādamu) and often referred to simply as Stardom (stylized as STARD✪M),[2] is a Japanese joshi puroresu or women's professional wrestling promotion, founded in September 2010 by former Hyper Visual Fighting Arsion and JDStar promoter Rossy Ogawa, retired wrestler, model and mixed martial artist Fuka Kakimoto and veteran professional wrestler Nanae Takahashi. Stardom quickly became one of the top joshi puroresu promotions, largely thanks to gravure idol Yuzuki Aikawa becoming the promotion's public face.

show.name: The Proud Family: Louder and Prouder
The Proud Family: Louder and Prouder
show.summary: A continuation of the acclaimed series, "The Proud Family: Louder and Prouder" follows the adventures and misadventures of newly 14-year-old Penny Proud and her Proud Family as they navigate modern life with hilarity and heart. The 2020s brings new career highs for mom Trudy, wilder dreams for dad Oscar and new challenges for Penny, including a socially woke neighbor who thinks she has a lot to teach her, bullying social media influencers who want to cancel her and her own teenage hormones. Penny's friends return, including Dijonay, LaCienega, Zoey and Michael. Penny's Suga Mama also returns, ready as ever to dispense tough love or a gentle hand whenever Penny needs it. Among the new faces are Maya and KG, new kids who not only have to deal with the struggles of being the new kid but also having two dads, a first for Smithville.

show.name: The Great Indian Kapil Show
show.summary: Comedian Kapil Sharma hosts this laugh-out-loud variety talk show with celebrity guests, hilarious antics and his signature supporting cast.

show.name: Jue Shi Zhan Hun
show.summary: On the Canglan Continent, warriors cultivate their power by communicating with heaven and earth through their martial spirits. Our protagonist, Qin Nan, the young master of the Qin family, accidentally obtains a fragment of the soul of the God of War, a mysterious being from the ancient era. From that moment on, Qin Nan defies his destiny and begins an upward journey. Along his way, he meets beautiful immortal women, defeats celestial geniuses, and becomes invincible in all battles, eventually becoming a supreme and revered Celestial God.

show.name: Police in Love
show.summary:
Marry me? Just six months and we'll be divorced. 

Inspector Thiartha's mother gives him an ultimatum. To counteract his bad luck, he'll have to marry someone born Monday, the thirteenth of October. As if that weren't hard enough, their first and last names must contain the Thai consonant ro ruea. Turns out that his junior, Police Senior Sergeant Major Mangkorn, was born on exactly that day, name as prescribed, perfect to the last item.

show.name: Mr. Fanboy
show.summary: University student Wan has a fanboy hobby, following and photographing rising star Nine. When Wan gets a casting opportunity for a support role in a Y series his idol will be starring in, he meets Third, a sharp-tongued leading man and Nine's ship partner. The two clash immediately, but when Wan passes his audition, the two are forced to work together. Despite their dislike for one another, after getting to know Third, Wan starts to look at his rival in a different light. He doesn't know what's wrong with him, but he finds himself avoiding the cocky leading man's gaze more and more often. Beyond that, Wan comes to learn that behind the curtain, the industry that looked so splendid isn't all as he'd thought. Even Nine, his own idol, is hiding something shady.

show.name: Under her rules
show.summary: Alice, a fresh graduate, meets her intense and alluring boss Nannalin. As boundaries blur between work, desire, and power, Alice must decide—escape her demanding boss or surrender under her rules?

show.name: WWE Lucha Libre AAA
show.summary: WWE Lucha Libre AAA highlights their partnership, blending WWE's global reach with AAA's rich Mexican tradition, focusing on shared talent like Rey Mysterio and Dominik Mysterio in explosive crossover events like Worlds Collide and TripleMania, showcasing vibrant lucha libre action for new audiences worldwide.

show.name: Not yours
show.summary:
To repay his father's debt, Pao Bei is forced to work at the mansion of the cold and wealthy P'Eng. Bound by a contract, the two go from mutual dislike to becoming increasingly drawn to each other. When a stolen diamond ring exposes dark secrets within P'Eng's powerful family, the wounds hidden beneath his icy exterior gradually come to light. Meanwhile, Pao Bei's best friend Jiang Weibang unexpectedly reunites with his former rival Li Milan, who is now a popular celebrity. They immediately fall back into their old habit of trading barbs, only to find themselves attracted to each other all over again. Two couples, two fated romances—from bitter rivalry to love completely out of control!

A new adaptation of the best-selling novel by ""Cutie Pie"" author BamBam.

show.name: The D Dorm
show.summary: When Dobby declares his intent to sell the D Dorm, he ends up on a mission to find the first love of Danai, Dobby's late grandfather and now resident ghost of the dorm, in exchange for selling the property. On top of that, he must deal with the quirky residents of the dorm who pull out all the stops to block the sale. How will it all turn out for the long-lost first love, The D Dorm, and the fate of its residents?

show.name: Zeri Feisheng
show.summary: In the chaotic times, demons and monsters roam freely, and treacherous officials are in power. With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins...

show.name: The Weekend View
show.summary: The Weekend View will focus on the biggest stories in entertainment and the buzziest news topping social media feeds. With all-new "Hot Topics," the co-hosts will give their one-of-a-kind takes with their signature candor and humor. Plus, "The Weekend View" will include "Behind the Table" segments with executive producer Brian Teta and the co-hosts as they dive deeper into pop-culture stories from the week.

show.name: A Tale of the Secret Saint
A Tale of the Secret Saint
show.summary: Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she's the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes…and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!

show.name: ABC News Live Weekend
show.summary: ABC News Live Weekend will feature the biggest stories of the week with all the facts and analysis viewers need to reflect on global events and prepare for what's coming next.

show.name: Magical Explorer
show.summary:
The legendary bishoujo game "Magical★Explorer"

I was reincarnated not as the protagonist surrounded by heroines thanks to my cheat abilities, but as Takine Kousuke, the unfortunate friend character who just puts on a forced smile beside them ...!

In the original game, he's inconspicuous, unrewarded, and remains a supporting character until the very end. But I have the knowledge from my past life, having played this game to its fullest extent! Furthermore, this friend character has a hidden ability: "the world's highest magical power," potentially surpassing even the protagonist...?

In order to lead the heroines he has longed for and met in this world to happy endings, his friend Kousuke fights his way through this world!

show.name: Dreamland
show.summary: Ever since his mother died in a fire, Terrence has drifted through life in a fog of apathy, terrified by any flame. The same nightmare haunts him every night, until he finally confronts his phobia. By overcoming his fear, Terrence becomes a Voyager, able to command fire and cross into Dreamland, the mysterious dimension where humanity's dreams and nightmares come to life.

show.name: Maskorama
show.summary: Based on the international hit "The Masked Singer", in Maskorama eight elebrities will face off against one another with a twist: each singer is using masks and costumes, the judges panel will have to guess which celebrity is behind the mask.

show.name: Wie is de Mol?
show.summary: Wie is de Mol? is a Dutch TV game show in which 10 contestants go to a foreign location, where they have to complete various assignments and puzzles in order to earn money. Although, one of the ten contestants is "De Mol", Dutch for the mole, whose role is to sabotage as much of the game as he or she can without the others noticing this.

show.name: Cook's Country from America's Test Kitchen
Cook's Country from America's Test Kitchen
show.summary: "Cook's Country from America's Test Kitchen" is a half-hour cooking show distributed to public television stations (reruns airing on Create) in the United States, which are also available in most Canadian markets. The show's hosts are Julia Collin Davison & Bridget Lancaster; the show and the magazine are affiliated, and the magazine's test kitchen facility in Brookline, Massachusetts, is used as a set for the show. Cook's Illustrated's parent company, Boston Common Press, while retaining its corporate name, has marketed its publishing and media activities under the America's Test Kitchen brand beginning in 2004.
